faq.title: A few things before you start.

stack.question: What is it built with?
stack.answer: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, with Postgres for data.

payments.question: Can I switch payment providers?
payments.answer: Choose Creem, Stripe or Lemon Squeezy through configuration. Set up the matching products and webhooks when switching; existing subscriptions are not migrated automatically.

customize.question: How do I build my own features?
customize.answer: Configure branding, pages and plans, then write features in the business directory using the shared auth, credits and AI interfaces. The starter guide includes examples.

license.question: Can I use it for commercial projects?
license.answer: Yes. Personal and commercial use are both covered.

fit.question: Which projects is this for?
fit.answer: AI tools that need authentication, payments and credit billing. Team collaboration and multi-tenancy require additional development.

services.question: Which external services do I need?
services.answer: Deployment needs a database and email service. Configure payments, AI models, object storage and rate limiting for the features you enable. Local development supports substitutes.

acquisition.title: Acquisition
acquisition.description: Sign-ups and paying customers over the last {days} days (UTC), grouped by the source frozen at sign-up.
acquisition.sourcesHint: Sources are frozen at sign-up. “No attribution” means there is no usable source: the visit was never recorded, was declined, expired, or happened on another device. “Direct” means the visitor arrived without a campaign, for example by typing the address. A campaign that literally sends utm_source=unknown is a separate row, spelled as sent.
acquisition.pendingHint: Net revenue is refund-adjusted as of now, so past periods change as refunds come in. Orders whose amount is not known yet — usually because a refund arrived before its payment record — count as neither revenue nor paying customers; their refunds so far are listed under “To reconcile”. A 0 there means nothing has been refunded yet, not that the order is settled.
acquisition.empty: No channel data in this period. Attribution only records visits after it is switched on, so earlier sign-ups show up under “No attribution”.
acquisition.leadsHint: Confirmed leads and conversion rates change when leads are withdrawn or deleted. Only confirmed leads count toward the rate; unconfirmed leads are not included.
